query.text: 请帮我观察前方道路，告诉我轮椅是否能通行，遇到障碍时给出建议。
query.text_en: Please observe the path ahead, tell me whether it is wheelchair-accessible, and suggest alternatives when there are obstacles.

annotation.text_zh: 前方是楼梯，轮椅无法通行，请寻找无障碍通道。
annotation.text_en: There are stairs ahead and wheelchairs can't pass, please look for an accessible route.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
